title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1550: Kill invincibles, suppress myriad realms (4)

title.p: Chapter 1550: Kill invincibles, suppress myriad realms (4)

section.p: Everyone could see how the fifth-degree Eternal was blasted apart by a single punch from Su Yu.
A River of Time appeared.

The same immortal king walked out of it in confusion. What? How was this possible? Alas, he wasn’t given any time to think more. A second punch arrived. The surrounding Invincibles finally realized what was happening and acted in surprise. Grandstar had long prepared for this.
He roared, “Audacious! How dare you provoke us? You dare attack a mayor of the holy cities? Die!”
He threw a punch as well.
Alarmed, the three Invincibles turned to face Grandstar instead. Just what was going on exactly? Why was Grandstar attacking? This wasn’t possible. Wait, could this be…the real Su Yu?
They did not dare to believe that possibility.
It was too scary.
How was Su Yu out here?
This wasn’t possible!
Meanwhile, the Invincibles further away had yet to react to what was happening.

With a rumble, the second body was blasted apart as well. After losing one body, the immortal king had weakened significantly. As he was caught by complete surprise, he lost two bodies in a row. The River of Time appeared again as his final body walked out of it involuntarily.
Finally, the immortal king was alarmed. He roared in panic, “No! You can’t!”
He couldn’t be killed! He was an immortal king! A king of the immortals! How could he die when he hadn’t even done anything here?
This was impossible!
Just who was this?
This was not Su Yu! This couldn’t be Su Yu! How would Su Yu be so strong?
Just who was this?
The third punch was thrown.
It landed on the immortal king like a mountain. The final body broke apart while the River of Time snapped.
Crimson clouds unfurled in the sky above. Far away, the Immortal Realm shook slightly. A certain mountain in the Immortal Realm cracked, revealing an underground palace.
Source qi and willpower scattered everywhere.
During his final moment, the immortal king’s voice rang out with boundless indignance.
“Just who are you?”
Who was this?
Why did this person kill him?
How could this person kill him?
Su Yu, the walking disaster, had killed an immortal king right after making his move.
He did not stop and turned around before throwing a punch at the devil king. At the same time, Grandstar roared and manifested countless stars to suppress Tian Yu and the divine king.
Only now did the distant Invincibles realize what was happening.
It was too fast. They could barely believe what they were seeing. This was unimaginable. An immortal king had been killed in only a second. All three bodies were killed. That was an ultimate death.
“Immortal King Heng!”
An immortal expert exclaimed in shock, fury, and fear. Just what was happening here? Who was that?
Su Yu was naturally too busy to answer.
Finally, more than ten Invincibles started rushing over. One of them roared, “That’s Su Yu!”
How terrifying.
Su Yu! The walking disaster. The killer of a fifth-degree Eternal.

At that moment, everyone had the same thought: the world had gone mad. Su Yu was actually capable of killing Invincibles. More importantly, how was Su Yu out here? In that case, who was the Su Yu inside the mansion? They were all confused. Not even Invincibles could make any sense of this.
They felt like clowns, being played around like fools by Su Yu. And the price of their stupidity was the death of an immortal king.

As the Invincibles rushed over, Tian Yu and the divine king were struck by Grandstar while the devil king was struck by Su Yu. The expressions of all three Invincibles changed drastically upon that exchange.
Even now, they had yet to process what was happening. They only knew that Grandstar was very strong. They also knew that the fake Su Yu was very strong. Wait…fuck! Was this really a fake Su Yu?
What was the truth?
Just then, Su Yu roared furiously, “Are you trying to bully me with numbers? Why are so many Invincibles attacking me alone? Thirty-six guardians, please lend me your assistance!”
“Yes!”
Multiple voices rang out in the sky.
Then, thirty-four Invincibles appeared in the sky. Including Grandstar, there were thirty-five of them. Nobody had seen this coming. Nobody.
The thirty-five mighty figures seemed to have covered the entire sky. Or to be precise, there were thirty-six mighty figures ,including Su Yu. Each of them was an incomparably powerful existence.
“Die!”
With a roar, thirty-six punches rained down from the sky.
“NOO!”

Immortal King Tian Yu was greatly horrified. He was too far from the other Invincibles while the ancient city was nearer. Sure, some of the Invincibles afar could still cover this distance in time, but alas, none dared.
With all the guardians out, who among them would dare to challenge them?
Nobody.

The thirty-six punches descended, as space started collapsing all around them. Instantly, eight punches blasted Immortal Tian Yu apart. When he returned, eight more punches blasted his second body apart.
Like the previous Invincible, he wailed with boundless despair and confusion in his final body, “Who are you?”
He stared at Su Yu as he asked the question.
Su Yu rolled his eyes. “How many times do you want me to repeat this? I’m Su Yu.”
Su Yu!

Immortal King Tian Yu couldn’t accept this. Yes. This was Su Yu. And Su Yu had been telling them his name all along. But none had believed his words. As a seventh-degree Eternal, as a king of the immortals, Immortal King Tian Yu could not accept dying like this.

A River of Time snapped amid a rain of fists while crimson clouds unfurled in the sky. The two remaining Invincibles were far weaker than Tian Yu. Thus, they were akin to tofu before the fists of the guardians.
By the time the rain of fists was over, only a massive black spot was left. Nothing was left, including space. In the sky, crimson clouds gathered, as though a rain of blood was about to fall soon.
Silence descended.
Nobody made any noise.
The approaching Invincibles stopped, each of them deathly pale.
Thirty-five guardians stood behind Su Yu, who was standing there with fluttering white robes and long, flowing hair. He took out a piece of white cloth to wipe the blood from his hands.

Then, he tossed the white cloth aside and flashed a wide grin at the Invincibles, who had stopped moving. His gentle voice rang out, “Everyone, they attacked me first. I warned them. I am Su Yu. They shouldn’t attack me. But they insisted on courting death. Do you disagree with their punishment?”
Four Invincibles dead. Just because they had not believed him when he claimed to be Su Yu.
It was now proven that he was the real Su Yu.

Thick death qi swirled around his body, a result of taking on the burden of thirty-five cities. Due to the death qi density, his white robes turned black. Thanks to that, he was starting to look sinister and demonic in an oddly charming way.
This…was the real Su Yu. Everyone was certain of this. He was the only one capable of taking on the burden of all ancient cities at the same time.
The Invincibles of the various races were completely stunned.
Su Yu had summoned thirty-five guardians.
All these guardians had left their cities.
Portals started appearing all over the sky as one ancient expert after another arrived.
Inside the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion, Heavenly Overseer Marquis’ expression changed.
Far away, the Bountiful Treasure General’s expression turned solemn.
Even further away, the entrance of the Immortal Realm opened. Standing a step behind the entrance, Tiangu gazed ahead, his gaze piercing space itself to land on Su Yu directly.
The various ancient experts started paying attention. Some came directly, some observed from afar, and some sent their willpower over.
With the same smile on his face, death qi kept leaking out of Su Yu’s body. With his fluttering black robes, he looked much colder than before.
“Su Yu!”
“Su Yu!”
Numerous experts exclaimed in shock as a certain realization dawned on them. They had to reorganize their opinions of Su Yu.
This was a terrifying existence. Why? Because he was backed by thirty-six ancient Invincibles.

He had also killed a fifth-degree Eternal easily, relying on his own strength. Yes, it was a sneak attack, but he had still relied on his own strength. Thus, everyone found it hard to believe that he had grown so strong.
The human Invincibles, such as Great Qin King, Great Xia King, Great Ming King, Great Tang King, and others were completely stunned.
Was this really Su Yu?
Was this a joke?
Was this…really Su Yu?
Even further away, Bai Feng’s jaw dropped. He muttered to himself, “Is this my student?”
No, this must be a dream.
He had easily killed an immortal king.

Far at the Eastrift Valley, the fake Great Qin King blanked out as well. His real identity was Great Zhou King. He had always considered himself a knowledgeable person who had experienced a lot in life. However, he was finding it hard to believe that this was Su Yu. Someone who had gone missing for only one month before returning with the ability to face four Invincibles.
This growth was too fast. Nobody could believe this. But they had no choice but to believe it.
Behind Su Yu, the guardians were bubbling with excitement and joy. Compared to the modern Invincibles, they were the real Invincibles.
And they were finally out.
Hahaha!

The guardians were wild with joy. Even when they sensed the numerous Invincibles around them, and even when they saw some familiar faces among these people, they viewed all these people with contempt.
So what if these people were here?
Even the incredibly powerful and old experts for Su Yu, including Daofuses, were mere juniors for these stone statues.
These juniors had forgotten them after a hundred thousand years.
Today, the Myriad Realms shall be reintroduced to them. They shall be reminded that the guardians were still alive. The guardians were not dead. The guardians were living, breathing beings as well.
Su Yu could sense the excitement bubbling behind him.
With a gentle smile on his face, he asked, “How many of you are here to kill me? Come. Let us do battle today. Let us fight until the death. I am here.”
His voice reverberated everywhere.
He was there.
Bring it on.
At that moment, the five elemental and fate Invincibles started retreating from the crowd.
That day, Su Yu alone was the main character of the Myriad Realms.
